faq-1.question: How does Memories to Melody work?
faq-1.answer: You tell us your story in a guided five-minute studio — who the song is for, the occasion, the memories that matter, and the sound you love. We turn that into custom lyrics and a fully produced song, then deliver it on a private listening page you can share whenever the moment is right.

faq-2.question: How long until my song is ready?
faq-2.answer: Most songs are ready within 48 hours, and many arrive the same day. Priority delivery on Premium and Cinematic packages moves you to the front of the queue. You can follow progress live from your dashboard, and we email you the moment your song is ready.

faq-3.question: What do I need to prepare before I start?
faq-3.answer: Just a few memories. The studio asks simple questions — how you met, an inside joke, a moment you will never forget. Two or three honest details are enough; you do not need to write anything polished. The more specific the memory, the more personal the song feels.

faq-4.question: Can I choose the music style and voice?
faq-4.answer: Yes. Pick from 16+ genres — pop, acoustic, R&B, country, gospel, Arabic, Latin and more — then set the mood and the vocal style: female, male, duet, or choir blend. Not sure? Our guided defaults produce a beautiful result every time.

faq-5.question: Can the song be in another language?
faq-5.answer: Yes — songs can be written and sung in English, French, Spanish, or Arabic. Listen to the multilingual songs on the examples page to hear how natural they sound.

faq-6.question: What if I want changes to my song?
faq-6.answer: Every package includes revision credits. From your dashboard you can request changes to lyrics, the pronunciation of names, tempo, mood, or vocals, and we will produce a new version of your song. Most revisions are delivered within 24 hours.

faq-7.question: Who owns the song — can I share it online?
faq-7.answer: You receive a lifetime personal-use license: listen, download, gift it, play the song at your event, and share it with friends and family, including on your personal social media. Commercial use such as ads or monetized content requires a separate license — just contact us.

faq-8.question: How do I give the song as a gift?
faq-8.answer: Every order includes a private listening page with cover artwork, synchronized lyrics, and an optional gift-reveal mode that builds anticipation before the song plays. Share the link by text or email — or play it in person and watch their reaction.

faq-9.question: Is my story kept private?
faq-9.answer: Completely. Your answers and uploaded files are used only to create your song and live in private storage. Listening pages are private by default, and you control how they are shared.

faq-10.question: What is included in each package?
faq-10.answer: Essential includes personalized lyrics, a fully produced song, a private listening page, and an MP3 download. Higher packages add more formats, artwork, and revisions. All are one-time payments — no subscription.

faq-11.question: Can I download the song and keep it forever?
faq-11.answer: Yes. Every package includes an MP3 download, and your listening page does not expire. Higher packages may add studio-quality WAV files. The song is yours to keep, replay, and pass on.

faq-12.question: What if I am not happy with the result?
faq-12.answer: We will make it right. Start with your included revision credits — most concerns are solved with a lyric or vocal change. If a verified quality issue cannot be resolved through revisions, our refund policy applies within 14 days of delivery.
